description_en: Queries the top 10 URLs that trigger protection rules the most
description_zh: 查看触发防护规则次数最多的前10个URL
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-rule-hits-top-url --start-timestamp 1665331200 --resource www.aliyundoc.com --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRuleHitsTopUrl

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the end time is the current query time
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，单位：秒。如果不设置该参数，结束时间为当前的查询时间
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The type of protection rule hit by the protected object. By default, this parameter is not specified, which indicates that all rules are displayed.

blacklist: IP blacklist.

custom: Custom rule.

antiscan: Scan protection rule.

cc_system: HTTP flood mitigation rule.

region_block: Location blacklist
parameters.help_zh:
防护对象命中的规则类型。默认不设置该参数，表示显示全部规则。

blacklist: 表示命中IP黑名单。

custom：表示命中自定义规则。

antiscan: 表示命中扫描防护规则。

cc_system:  表示命中CC防护规则。

region_block: 表示区域封禁
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看您当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

WAF实例所属地域。取值：

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
